comments.value: I don't think VRChat wants to verify the age of their user themself which is why they went with a third-party (probably for legal reasons as well). I don't think there are any other ways of verifying someone age without handing your ID or a valid document that can prove without a doubt that you are not lying about your age.

details:
Honestly, age verification is a great feature that will make it a lot easier for adults to be adults while preventing kids from seeing things they shouldn’t. Allowing NSFW content is good, unambiguously, as is preventing minors from being exposed to it. 

But here’s the thing: A lot of people I know, frankly, know better than to trust sensitive info like their government ID to any verification service, no matter how trusted or secure they seem. Discord somewhat recently got into trouble because, despite claims to the contrary, IDs were being stored, and this was only discovered due to a data breach. I know plenty of people who would like to be able to access NSFW content, but wouldn’t be comfortable handing their ID to a third party. I don’t exactly know what alternatives may be available, but I think they’re worth exploring, for the safety of the users.

I say all this as someone who’s already age verified. I put my trust in VRChat to choose an age verification service that doesn’t put my identity at risk. But, there are a lot of very good reasons for some not to share that trust, and I think there should be an alternative for them.
title: Alternative Age Verification Process
